6.title: Investiture of the Mayor's Chain of Office

content.string: Councillor Todd J. Cornelius invests His Worship Josh Morgan with the Mayor's Chain of Office.
Sergeant-at-Arms Brahmtej Singh Gujral raises the Mace.
His Worship Mayor Josh Morgan calls the meeting to order and delivers the Inaugural Address.
That it BE NOTED that no pecuniary interests were disclosed.

motion_texts.string: That the following actions BE TAKEN with respect to the Appointment of Deputy Mayor and Budget Chair Policy and the Remuneration for Elected Officials and Appointed Citizen Members Policy:

a) the Civic Administration BE DIRECTED to bring forward a by-law to the November 17th meeting of Municipal Council to amend By-law No. CPOL.-417-268 being the “Appointment of Deputy Mayor and Budget Chair Policy” to provide for the provision of two Deputy Mayors; one serving a four-year term, the other a two-year term; and

b) the Civic Administration BE DIRECTED to bring forward a by-law to the November 17th meeting of Municipal Council to amend By-law No. CPOL.-70-302 being the “Remuneration for Elected Officials and Appointed Citizen Members Policy” to delete section 4.4 and replace it with the following new section 4.4:

“Additional compensation for Deputy Mayor and Budget Chair positions shall be equal to 5% of the annual base remuneration established for a Councillor. The additional compensation provided under this section shall be adjusted concurrently with any annual adjustment to Councillor remuneration under this Policy.”;
it being noted that the City Clerk acknowledges, with thanks, the communication received from Hon. Robert J. Flack, Minister of Municipal Affairs and Housing.

That the appointment of Councillor Shawn Lewis as Deputy Mayor for the City of London, for a term commencing on November 17, 2026, and ending on November 15, 2030, to carry out such responsibilities as set out and as provided for in the “Appointment of Deputy Mayor and Budget Chair Policy” and the Council Procedure By-law, BE APPROVED.

That the appointment of Councillor Corrine Rahman as Deputy Mayor for the City of London, for a term commencing on November 17, 2026, and ending on November 17, 2028, to carry out such responsibilities as set out and as provided for in the “Appointment of Deputy Mayor and Budget Chair Policy” and the Council Procedure By-law, BE APPROVED.
That Councillor Steve Lehman BE APPOINTED Chair of the 2024-2027 Multi-Year Budget Committee;
it being noted that Mayoral Decision No. 2026-002, regarding the appointment of the 2024-2027 Multi-Year Budget Committee Chair and Vice Chair was issued November 17th, 2026
